summary: Full regression of the Rewind demo todo app on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 390x844: product smoke check plus day-01 through day-04 scenarios, including empty and spaces-only titles, trimming, a 500-character title, 20 quick adds, tick/untick, middle and bulk delete, keyboard-only use, reload, back, rapid clicks, and HTML/special-character titles. The app behaved as specified on both viewports, with no console errors and no layout overflow. No new bugs were found; known-bugs.json was empty.

scenarios.title: Product smoke check on desktop and mobile
scenarios.notes: Page loads with Todos heading, add two todos in order, mark first done then undo, delete second, footer Format version 1, keyboard-only works. No console errors.

scenarios.title: Open the app
scenarios.notes: Heading Todos, New todo field, Add button, No todos yet., and Format version 1 are visible. No console errors.

scenarios.title: Add a todo with the Add button
scenarios.notes: Walk the dog appears in the list and the field clears.

scenarios.title: Add a todo with Enter
scenarios.notes: Buy groceries is added at the end of the list.

scenarios.title: Reject empty and spaces-only titles
scenarios.notes: Add and Enter with empty or spaces-only input add nothing.

scenarios.title: Trim surrounding spaces
scenarios.notes: Buy milk   appears as Buy milk.

scenarios.title: 500-character title stays usable
scenarios.notes: Long title is added; layout does not overflow on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Add 20 todos quickly
scenarios.notes: All 20 appear in the order they were added.

scenarios.title: Tick and untick a todo
scenarios.notes: Ticked item looks done (strikethrough); untick restores normal text.

scenarios.title: Delete a todo in the middle
scenarios.notes: Only the deleted todo disappears; neighbors stay.

scenarios.title: Footer format version
scenarios.notes: Footer shows Format version 1 on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Add, toggle, and delete with keyboard only
scenarios.notes: Tab, typing, Enter, and Space complete add, tick/untick, and delete.

scenarios.title: Repeat S2 to S10 on mobile
scenarios.notes: Same flows work at 390x844 with no horizontal overflow.

scenarios.title: Day 02 smoke (session format, no UI change)
scenarios.notes: Desktop and mobile smoke check passed; no regression.

scenarios.title: Day 03 smoke (DOM snapshot, no UI change)
scenarios.notes: Desktop and mobile smoke check passed; no regression.

scenarios.title: Day 04 smoke (incremental mutations, no UI change)
scenarios.notes: Desktop and mobile smoke check passed; no regression.
